newsitem.title: BRAZIL: German Allianz moves LatAm headquarters to Brazil.
newsitem.headline: German Allianz moves LatAm headquarters to Brazil.

text.p: Germany's insurance group Allianz AG Holding next month will move to Brazil from Venezuela its Latin American headquarters, a company spokeswoman said.
"Allianz is moving to Rio de Janeiro because it wants to be closer to the promising Brazilian market," the spokeswoman said.
Some analysts forecast the country's insurance market to grow 15 percent annually over the next five years, with premiums reaching $30 billion in 2001 from the current $14 billion.
The move to Rio will also allow the firm to strengthen its team in Brazil and expand industrial insurance services to Brazilian and Mercosur clients, she said.
Earlier this month, Allianz invested $21.5 million to increase its voting stake to 48.5 percent in Allianz-Bradesco Seguros S/A, a 23-year old joint-venture with Brazilian insurer Bradesco Seguros.
Among Allianz-Bradesco major clients are pharmaceutical, auto and white-goods firms.
